title: Merapi volcanic observations
summary: Simulated demo scenario at a real volcano (Merapi, Smithsonian GVP 263250). The records are fixtures modelled on satellite thermal, sulfur dioxide and radar deformation products; they do not describe Merapi's current or past activity, and the scenario dates are fictional. Review states are illustrative workflow rules, not official alert levels.

title: Riau peatland hotspots
summary: Simulated static example for the wildfire and haze module: one satellite thermal detection over peatland and one haze note. The values do not describe real fires, and the scenario dates are fictional. A hotspot needs contextual review before anyone treats it as a confirmed fire.
